recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Plurinational State of Bolivia. Presidential republic.
capital: La Paz (administrative capital); Sucre (constitutional [legislative and judicial] capital) · at approximately 3,630 m above sea level, La Paz's elevation makes it the highest capital city in the world
economy: resource-rich economy benefits during commodity booms; has bestowed juridical rights to Mother Earth, impacting extraction industries; increasing Chinese lithium mining trade relations; hard hit by COVID-19; increased fiscal spending amid poverty increases; rampant banking and finance corruption GDP (PPP): $122.2 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Bolivian Armed Forces (Fuerzas Armadas de Bolivia or FAB): Bolivian Army (Ejercito de Boliviano), Bolivian Navy (Armada Boliviana), Bolivian Air Force (Fuerza Aerea Boliviana) Ministry of Government: National Police (Policía Nacional de Bolivia, PNB) (2025) Expenditure: 1.2% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
